name: v2.5.26
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26

- fix(nav): move focus to the view selector when pressing Up from the Favourites grid top row (#159)
- fix(favourites): keep the selected cover visible after the zoom animation in Cover Flow (#158)
- fix(flasher): patch Dependabot high-severity transitive vulns
- site: move osmiumsound.it to the osmium-sound-site repo
- ci: make core/ modules importable in build-ui-ota tests
- docs: remove companion workflow docs, point to the new repo
- site: point the companion section to osmium-companion-android
- ci: stop publishing the F-Droid repo from the image pipeline
- build: drop the Android companion, now homed in osmium-companion-android
- build: bump core/ submodule to alpha 3692055 (NP favicon from core)
- build(x86): drop the root app-code duplicates, now sourced from core/
- ci(x86): read app code from the core/ submodule in all build workflows
- build(x86): read app code from core/ submodule; add platform.conf
- build: add osmium-core as the core/ submodule (tracks alpha)
- refactor(core): make the app layer platform-clean on the x86 base (Phase 1)
- fix(qt): artist favourite heart toggles, and tame the block-artist confirm
- feat(lms): give the Recommended plugin an icon and move it into My Music
- ci: include the LMS plugins in the OTA system payload
- feat(lms): ship a plugin that shows Recommended in Material Skin
- fix(remote): stop the Qt key path from storming during a BT re-link
- fix(remote): tame the Fire TV remote going erratic after a BT re-link
- fix(ui): let the remote reach the "–" to drop a Recommended album
- feat(recommend): record per-source candidate and picked counts in the run summary
- fix(#151): add "Add to favourites" and "Go to artist" to the popup menu
- fix(#144): Album Artist tiles match Album view (Play button + context menu)
- fix(favourites): #148 #149 #150 — album-grid layout, artist line, own cover
- fix(#152): spell "Favourites" consistently in the English locale
- revert: restore api_server on TCP 127.0.0.1:8000
- fix(np): invoke build-qt.sh via bash and mark vendored scripts executable
- security: replace api_server TCP loopback with Unix socket
- feat(np): build the Now Playing web page in CI and ship it to /opt/hifi-np
- fix(recommend): make the manual run route return JSON, not a bare bool
- feat(np): Now Playing web build backend, direct access, and admin entry
- fix(remote): ignore reconnect bursts and phantom repeats from a BT remote
- fix(kiosk): drive the GPU with the internal panel on switchable-graphics laptops
- website: point the Development download to v2.5.26-dev.6

- feat(setup): add the driver step to the first-boot captive, bundle WIP

- chore(alpha): bundle working-tree WIP for the alpha5 build
- feat(kiosk): Recommended albums open AlbumPage, with Cover Flow and CD changer
- fix(lms): bump OsmiumConvert version so the #140 plugin rules actually ship
- chore(kiosk): the dev mock answers needed_albums like the real API
- fix(recommend): the empty screen counts streaming favourites too
- feat(recommend): streaming favourites and Deezer history shape the taste profile
- ui(kiosk): hour and minute of the Recommended run as labelled steppers
- fix(kiosk): put the Recommended lines of Browser.qml where they belong
